{{Quote|You have a name? I don't want to keep calling you "boy".''"<br />"''Xesh.''"<br />''"Of course. Should have guessed. It's written all over your face.|[[Daegen Lok]] and the Force Hound Xesh|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>}}
The letter {{AurB|x}} was the twenty-fourth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> It was pronounced "zesh", and had the value of /X/.

The [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] had the letter [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] in purple on his face.
